brief:
Palestinian Islamic Jihad movement held the Trump administration responsible Sunday for failing to curb the Israeli government under Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Shehab Wire reported. The faction said Netanyahu, wanted by the International Criminal Court on charges of war crimes and crimes against humanity, leads what it characterized as a government of war criminals requiring external restraint.

The statement marked a sharp criticism of U.S. policy toward Israel as the Trump administration entered its second term. Islamic Jihad's position reflected broader Palestinian faction opposition to American support for Israeli military operations and governance.
title: Islamic Jihad blames Trump administration for failing to restrain Netanyahu
